          python -c 'import json,os,pathlib; pathlib.Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"],"product-scope-receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(version=1,sha=os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"],run_id=int(os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ID"]),run_attempt=int(os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"]),report="product-scope.xml"))+"\n")'

        run: >-
          python -m pytest -q scripts/ci/tests/test_backend_shards.py
          scripts/ci/tests/test_backend_shard_failclosed.py
          scripts/ci/tests/test_ci_release_additions.py
          scripts/ci/tests/test_backend_shard_redis_setup.py
          --junitxml="$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-shards.xml"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: guard-executed-contracts-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/product-scope.xml
            ${{ runner.temp }}/product-scope-receipt.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ci-shards.xml
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Verify against the checker and manifest from trusted BASE
        id: integrity
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ needs.baseline.outputs.base_sha }}
        run: |
          CHECKER="$RUNNER_TEMP/check_regression_guards.py"
          if git cat-file -e "$BASE_SHA:scripts/ci/check_regression_guards.py" 2>/dev/null; then
            git show "$BASE_SHA:scripts/ci/check_regression_guards.py" > "$CHECKER"
            python "$CHECKER" --root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --base "$BASE_SHA"
          else
            echo "Bootstrap only: trusted BASE has no checker; no business guard protection claimed."
            python scripts/ci/check_regression_guards.py --base "$BASE_SHA" --allow-bootstrap
          fi
      - name: Preserve accepted process tests, fixtures and execution commands

          BASE_SHA: ${{ needs.baseline.outputs.base_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if git cat-file -e "$BASE_SHA:guards/PROCESS_CONTRACTS.json" 2>/dev/null; then
            git show "$BASE_SHA:scripts/ci/process_contracts.py" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/process_contracts.py"
            python "$RUNNER_TEMP/process_contracts.py" --root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --base "$BASE_SHA"

            python scripts/ci/process_contracts.py --base "$BASE_SHA" --bootstrap
          fi
